This provides evidence of activity in a selected previously treated population. The study used paclitaxel 100 mg/m², whereas this NCCP schedule lists 80 mg/m² with an optional consultant-selected 100 mg/m² start. Its group results cannot be treated as a prediction for the default dose or every patient.
